decisions.reason: Requesting a complete package with version _24 does not change the required style system or its existing coverage across all templates.
The package and versioning request does not modify the earlier task-local assessment method, coverage, or required outputs.

The source clearly assigns version _24 to all packaged templates, but it is unclear whether the candidate's target_template_version denotes the current template release and should replace V14 or preserves the specifically requested historical V14 test target.
Packaging all templates as version _24 does not change the approved bullet appearance or required level-4 variant.
The package version designation does not resolve or modify the required Tab-controlled list hierarchy.
The complete-package request does not change the required editable-field mechanism or its intended use.
Assigning version _24 to the package does not alter any typography values.
The source does not change the required theme colors or approved-color availability policy.
The package and naming decision does not modify or resolve the table-layout stability requirement.
The source changes package contents and version designation only, not paragraph, Enter-key, or spacing behavior.
Versioning the complete package does not alter field-label text, coverage, locations, or persistence.
Including the Board Meeting template in a versioned package does not change its confirmed row-extension workflow.
